steps.text: 11:00 A.M. \ Sunny, clear
Rhodes Island Dormitories
A heavy pelt tightly covers the window, the room barely illuminated by a cluster of candles.
A small Vulpo girl raises her bow and nocks an arrow, cautiously looking ahead.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: ...The terminal's ringing.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Noisy... How do I use this thing again?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Hello?
Vermeil...

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Huh, where'd it go... Sorry, Vermeil, give me a sec. That's weird, I could've sworn I just put it in the toolbox.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Oh, here it is! How'd it end up in the accessories box? Sorry to keep you waiting–– Hibiscus? What are you doing here?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Adnachiel, have you seen Vermeil?

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: I was just about to ask you. She was here a moment ago.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: I was adjusting her prosthetics and wanted to grab her some snacks, but she disappeared in the blink of an eye.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Any idea where she might be going next?

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Didn't ask. She's been on leave lately, right? She could be pretty much anywhere.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Though, you look like you're in quite a rush... Did something happen with her?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: She... She had an Oripathy treatment scheduled for today, but didn't show up at Medical this afternoon and also cancelled all her appointments.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: After I heard the news, I went over to her dorm, only to find that she wasn't there either. A lot of stuff seemed to be missing from her room too.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I asked around, and nobody seemed to know where she went. The people who did see her said she was heading out.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: That doesn't sound right. When she came to see me, she didn't seem to be acting particularly strangely. That said, there was one thing that stuck out.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: After I finished the tune-up, she suddenly gave me a gift with no explanation. The old her wouldn't have done anything like that, right?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: What did she give you? Mind if I take a look?

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Here, it's this.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: A beast tooth necklace...

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: By the way, Hibiscus, since you're already here, want to try the dessert I just made––

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Hey, don't just get up and leave like that!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Sorry, next time! Promise! I need to find Vermeil first and see what's going on.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Those are some serious bags around your eyes, Lina. Have you not been sleeping well lately?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: It's nothing to worry about, just dealing with a bit of overtime. You know how many field operators have been coming back from their missions lately, so Medical's been swamped all of a sudden.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: But that's perfectly normal. Lots of our seniors work way more overtime than we do, and once we get over the hump it should be smooth sailing.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: (Stops walking)

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: That's how life in the Medical Department goes. Sometimes you're crazy busy, other times there's not a whole lot to do. So don't worry, I'll be catching up on that sleep debt soon enou–– Whooa!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Vermeil? When did you get here?

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: And what are you doing lugging around all this stuff? Are you visiting home? Or maybe going on a trip to Dossoles?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: I'm not going home...

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Do you know where I can find medicinal herbs on Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Oh, are you not feeling well? I can do a quick check-up for you for right now, or take you down to Medical...

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: I'm fine. Just wanted to know where I can find some herbs. Do you know?

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: If you want herbs, I heard that Miss Lena has a variety of plants and flowers over at the Convalescent Garden. You might find something with medicinal value there.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Thanks. I'll go look for her.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Oh, this is for you.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: A polished bone fragment? ...What's it for?

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Huh? Where'd she go?

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Coming, coming.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Podenco, please don't bring any more orders here at this hour... Huh?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Lena...

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Oh, Vermeil? Please, come in.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Sorry, you're usually out in the field, so I didn't expect to see you in the rest area. It's quite unusual for you to come looking for me without notice.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Is there anything I can help you with?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: I'd like a few types of herbs. Do you have them here?

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: You're looking for plants with medicinal properties? No problem. Just tell me their names.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: ...I don't know what they're called, but I'll know when I see them.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Hmm... Then come take a look around the courtyard with me.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Did you find any of the plants you were looking for?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: This one, this one, and that grass with the little red flowers.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: (All flowers with soothing and calming properties...)

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Anything else? ...Hm?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Do you have that kind of grass... with a bunch of little bumps on the leaves?

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Grass with bumps on the leaves? Oh, are you talking about motherwort? It does help regulate emotions, so I planted some in the garden.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: If you cut your neck, you can chew 'em into pieces and stick it on the wound, and it won't hurt anymore.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Ehh...

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Those vines are very durable. Can use them to break bones.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: ...Let's not worry about that for now, Vermeil. Do you need any other plants?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: No, I'm good now.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Here, I've put everything in this box.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: These herbs are all very valuable, so I'll need to think about what I can offer in exchange for them.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Exchange?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: I can't give you my bow, or my arm... The only other thing of value I have on me is this dagger.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Here.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: There's no need for that. Here, just take them. You don't need to pay me for some herbs and flowers; there's plenty more in the garden.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: No. A hunt in exchange for a bounty, a job in exchange for a meal.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: A dagger... in exchange for Lena's herbs.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Vermeil, I don't need you to do that for me. Did something happen?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Not good enough? Then I'll think of something else I can give you...

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: That's not what I meant. The dagger's quite nice... Ugh, fine, maybe I can find some use for it around the garden... Alright, I'll take the dagger, okay?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Mhm.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: But listen to me – don't go around pushing your stuff onto other people in the future! Got it?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: I'll be taking the herbs then. Thank you. ...Bye, Lena.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Wait, Vermeil. I wanted to ask you – what... are you going to do with those plants?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Lena, I don't want to go yet.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: And that's what happened... By the time I got to the door, she was already gone without a trace.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Thank you... *sigh* Sounds like we'll need to look elsewhere. Hypothetically, if she needed to process the herbs next, then the lab would make sense... I'll head over and take a look.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Hibiscus, what did Vermeil mean when she said that? ...Is she going to leave Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: HR hasn't received a letter of resignation. She's been performing exceptionally in her field operations, and there's no way she failed her provisionary period.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: So... I'm just as confused about her situation as you are.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: What I'm more worried about is whether Executor told her properly when he first brought her here. That her home is—

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Don't worry, Lena.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Whatever prompted her to do all this, I'm not letting her go until I hear the full truth from her.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: I'm not allowed in right now?

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Sorry, the kitchen's already closed for the day.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Kitchenware. Where can I get kitchenware... I remember seeing instant noodle bowls in someone's office...

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Hold on a moment, please. Judging from your appearance, are you about to head out on a mission?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: My goodness. You can't just set off for a long journey on an empty stomach... I might have some dried food and canned sandworms in my room. I'll go grab them for you right now.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Could you keep an eye on this place while I'm gone? I'm in charge of security tonight, since people have been breaking into the kitchen and cafeteria in the dead of night.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Appreciate it! I'll be right back!

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: So, I can go into the back kitchen. Understood.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: What a sturdy metal door. Is this... a protective net?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Almost like it's been designed to keep out feral beasts. As expected of Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: You can't get in without a staff member's badge. Is there any other way in... Hmm, there's a keyhole hidden underneath, which can probably be picked.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: But... I gave my dagger to Lena.
♪Hummm.... Hmm-hmm.... Hmmm...♪

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: ...Hmm? This isn't the bar. It's—

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Shoot, I got way too absorbed in my music and I ended up walking all the way to the cafeteria.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: I need to head back now, or I'll miss the last batch of fins and chips...

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Who's there?! ––Huh? Vermeil?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Phew... Frostleaf.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: What are you doing here?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: (*gulp*––)

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Did you bring a knife? Can you lend it to me real quick?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Mm, here.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Thanks. I have nothing of value on me right now. I'll think of some way to repay you later.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Um, what exactly are you doing?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Cutting this wire here. Then, inserting the knife into this keyhole...

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Where did you learn to do stuff like this?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: The mercenary camp in Ursus. Give it a few tries and you'll figure it out.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: ...Wait, that's not the point! Are you trying to force open the kitchen door?!

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Yes, because that's where the kitchenware is... I need some.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: You need to stop that, now. If someone sees you, they might think you're a thief...

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Speaking of which, where's the usual worker from Logistics? Why aren't they here right now?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Found the lock cylinder. All that's left is...

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Okay. Door's open.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: I'm back–– Vermeil? Where'd you go?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: The staff worker's back!

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Vermeil, hurry up and leave already–– Huh? Why are you going inside?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: First pot secured. Second pot...

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Huh? Is someone in the kitchen?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Shoot, this is bad.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Just one more chunk of beast meat.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Vermeil! Go!

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: *pant*, *pant*... Nobody's chasing after us, right?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Nope... Frostleaf, you sure bolted out of there with the meat.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: I don't think that's anything to be proud of... W-Wait, what are you doing now?!

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Starting a fire.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: How are you going to start a fire HERE? And isn't it just going to trigger the alarm?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Nope. I come here all the time.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: ...In any case, I really need to get going.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: The bar's already closed.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: I grabbed two pots. This one, for the herbs. This one, for stewed meat.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Stewed meat?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: You helped me, so I'll give you some in return. Is that good enough?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: In return? What I did hardly counts as helping you out... Plus–

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Fair trade. That's the rule.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: ...Way back in Columbia, I saw some of the settlers in the barrens trading. The hunters would exchange their catch with the tribesmen for their daily necessities.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: That's how they could step into the wastes, one day at a time. Abiding by those rules.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Sounds familiar. Reminds me of my old life... A long, long time ago, before I was brought to Rhodes Island. Maybe even before that.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Someone brought you to Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: He said it was to treat my condition. And that my medical bills were already paid for.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: He didn't seem like a bad guy, but... he could hardly be called a good guy either. I didn't trust him. Things don't work like that in these lands.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Then, you should talk things through with the Doctor. The Doctor is a good person, and looks the part too.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: I already told the Doctor, or whatever. What I said is, I don't need anybody's charity. I earn my keep, and work for everything I have.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Didn't say anything back, so they must have agreed.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: ...Rhodes Island isn't that kind of place.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: You don't need to try and fool me. I've been to plenty of places outside the wilds. Ursus camps, and other settlements outside.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: It's true that you don't always need to trade with what you hunt yourself, but in places where you don't, you use shiny golden coins instead.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Every place has been like that, and I've seen plenty.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Oh, the water's ready.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Pour the water over the meat... and use the remaining water to boil the herbs. And then, close the lid.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Now we're good. Just give it a little while.
The Vulpo girl wipes her hands on the walls out of habit, then squats down on the edge of the platform. She looks outside blankly.
Rhodes Island is sailing across the land, and beneath its strong headlights, one can clearly see the gravel in its path being ground into fine dust.
A gust of wind sweeps across the barrens, and in its wake, not even that dust remains.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: As long as I sit here... Nobody will bother me. I can sit here for a long time.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Rhodes Island is a good place. A good home beyond home.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: But it is not my home...
Frostleaf looks at the back of the small figure in front of her and lets out a soft sigh.
Suddenly, she approaches that figure, and brings her headphones close to Vermeil.
The next moment, the sound of music flows into Vermeil's ears.
♪Don't need your promise, don't need your gifts♪
♪The sun always rises, and that's all it takes♪
♪So grab my hand, and let's set out on a trip♪
♪To the far horizon, or what's beyond it♪

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: This song... reminds me of what my old tribe used to sing. When we'd divide all the food up among us, and sing while clapping on the table...

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Thanks for sharing it with me. I'll find a way to—

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: The value of a song can't be measured, and it's not something you can trade for. The same is also true for... a whole lot of other things.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: How about this... If I can't stay here, then after I leave, I'll think carefully about your words.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Leave? For good? Where are you going?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: I can't stay in Rhodes Island. They won't let me.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Who's they?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Mm. The sun's about to come up. I need to hurry up and make the final push...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: What a pain... I've stayed up so many nights now that I can't even fall asleep...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Why does the hallway smell like burnt wood... *sniff* Whoa, something smells good.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Is that Vermeil... and Frostleaf?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Someone's found us. Vermeil?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Ver—

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: She's gone... along with the pot.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Wait––

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Seriously, where did that kid run off to?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: After making her way to the cafeteria, she disappeared without a trace... Could she be linked to that kitchen break-in last night?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: But there are way too many people who'd do that sort of thing, and Vermeil isn't one of the usual suspects.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: *sigh* I'm so hungry... I've been so caught up trying to find her that I forgot to eat dinner.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I wonder if there's anything left of the food Gavial hid in the office. It might not be healthy, but...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: It should be fine as long as I only pick out the vegetables... right? I mean, I need to keep my energy up to continue searching. And it's not like Gavial would mind... right?
*sigh*...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: (A noise coming from the office? Is someone working overtime?)

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Hello? Is someone in here?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Hibiscus?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Vermeil! So this is where you were!

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Are you working overtime, Hibiscus?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Where have you been? I was looking all over for you!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Why did you suddenly cancel today's treatment? Why did you say you were leaving Rhodes Island? Your Oripathy has only been temporarily suppressed, so you're far from being fully healed up!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I'm telling you now – you better have a good explanation! Otherwise, I'm not letting you out of my sight!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Don't tell me... Has someone been bullying you?! Don't worry, you tell me who it is, and I'll give them a piece of my mind!

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: I have something for you.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: For me?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Here–

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: (This pot... I think I've seen it in the cafeteria before...)

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Should I open the lid? What's inside?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: I was told that Medical has been very busy lately, and none of you are getting much sleep.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: I've also gone days without sleeping while out on the hunt. There are some herbs that make you feel a lot better when you boil them all together.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: I made some for you. Drink it, and if you feel better, that means I can do something helpful. And I will continue doing that for you.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Maybe then, that'll mean... that I can finally stay at Rhodes Island for my treatment.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: (Opens the lid)

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Umm...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Whoa... It smells amazing. Is this stewed meat?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Wrong one!

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Oh no, I... I must've grabbed the wrong pot! Hibiscus, let me go get the right one! Just wait here!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Hold on... You've been waiting here the whole time? Just to give me this?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: That's the reason you've been missing for the whole day?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: But this isn't what I wanted to give you...

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Sorry.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: But why did you say you have to give me that... herbal soup, before you can receive treatment?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Because my job's gone. If I want to stay here and continue getting treatment, then I need a new job. There's not much else I know how to do... Just this one thing.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: What are you talking about? I specifically went to confirm with HR, and the approval for your provisional period will be issued soon.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: But yesterday, someone from the HR Department contacted me and said that I no longer need to go on field operations.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Then I saw on my terminal that my applications for field operations for today, tomorrow, and next week had all been canceled.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: They won't let me stay here.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: ...Vermeil, this is all a huge misunderstanding.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: It's just... a misunderstanding?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: HR cancelled your missions... because you're on vacation right now.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: You've been doing way too much field work since you joined the company! I was worried that you were putting too much strain on your body, so I asked Medical to grant you special leave.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: And that leave officially began yesterday morning!

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Vacation? That means... I don't have to work, but can still receive treatment...?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: You're so silly. You've gone on so many field operations, and have done so much for all of us. How could you not be one of us?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: I'm one of you... Is that what you really believe?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Of course. So there's no need to worry about how much you have to pay us back. None of us care about that.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: It's your holiday right now, so you can do whatever you want, however you want. And we'll absolutely support you the whole way.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Rhodes Island is somewhere you can be at ease. That's why it exists in the first place.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Do you get it now?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Even if you don't, that's fine too! In any case, now that I've figured out what's going on... Phew, that's a load off my chest!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Oh, uhh, the pot of stewed meat! Quickly, find somewhere to put it! Since you made it for me, it can't hurt to try a few pieces, right?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Hibiscus, what is Rhodes Island to you...?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Here, take these utensils. Let's eat up! Dig in, and don't be shy! We need to finish everything before they show up to start their shift...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Huh? What were you asking me?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: ...Never mind, it's nothing.
Five days later, on the last day of Vermeil's vacation.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Good morning, Vermeil.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Good morning, Lina.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: You're right on time today too. Hibiscus is waiting for you inside.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Huh?
Vermeil stands outside, quietly looking at the doorplate of the Medical Department.
After a brief moment, she turns and walks inside the room.
Behind her, a handmade textile that she wove herself hangs silently on the door.
